whoItsFor: Developers and teams who want a self-hosted, provider-agnostic web interface for running local models (Ollama) and OpenAI-compatible APIs. The README also targets enterprises needing RBAC, SSO, and observability.
useCases: Chat with local Ollama models or any OpenAI-compatible API (LMStudio, OpenRouter, vLLM) from one interface
Build RAG over documents with vector databases and web search providers
Run team-wide AI access with per-group roles, permissions, and usage analytics
